prompt:
Subject: A negatively charged ion.

Composition: Show a simple educational model of a chloride ion as one large green sphere marked Cl⁻, surrounded by a faint electron-cloud outline. A small positive electrode plate stands nearby as part of the demonstration, emphasizing negative charge without a neutral atom label or a free-electron substitute.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. Allow only Cl⁻ on the ion and a plus sign on the positive electrode as essential charge notation. No other text, captions, speech balloons, labels, logos or watermark.
